subject: Decision scenarios and enablement: next steps for DataVerge
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah@dataverge.com>, Tom Singh <tom.singh@dataverge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap — decision scenarios & next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Decision scenarios we mapped
- Fast internal POC (6 weeks): technical team runs a scoped integration with a 1-vCPU test harness; goal = validate latency and KV-cache behavior for 3 production prompts.
- Pilot (Q4): Cross-functional pilot with 2 product teams, expected 25k tokens/day peak, aim to lock performance targets and cost model.
- Enterprise buy (Q1): SLA + reserved capacity + custom routing to EU region if needed.

2) Decision criteria you highlighted
- Clear economic owner (ROI/TCO) — you said Lena Ortiz will own economics
- Security & audit: SOC 2 evidence and logging for inference events
- Procurement timeline & SOW wording (data residency clause)

3) Asks / next steps
- Sarah: please confirm the economic buyer (Lena) and if we should involve legal in the next meeting.
- Tom: can you share DataVerge's procurement calendar (rough target dates) and any SOW templates/standard clauses?
- Redwood: we will share a focused ROI model, an abridged security Q&A, and a short champion talk-track document for Sarah.

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (30m), initial-roi-slide-deck.pdf (6 slides) — both uploaded to the Drive link below.

Proposed follow-ups: 30-min procurement sync (Tom + Lena + Ben) week of Oct 11, and a 60-min technical workshop (Priyom + DataVerge eng) week of Oct 18.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-roi-model
DocuSign placeholder (SOW): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/DV-SOW-2027

If that aligns, I’ll schedule both and circulate specific agendas.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Liu <sarah@dataverge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Singh <tom.singh@dataverge.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — decision scenarios & next steps

Ben — thanks for the thorough recap. This captures things well. A few clarifications on our side: 

- Economic buyer: confirmed — Lena Ortiz (VP Finance) will sign off on the TCO and procurement commitment. I’ll loop her into the procurement sync.
- Procurement timeline: our initial target is to have vendor selection by end of Nov; legal/procurement review in early Dec with final PO issuance in mid-Dec if everything looks good.
- Security: Tom (cc) will coordinate to get you our security questionnaire; we typically expect SOC 2 Type II and a brief answers doc for any third-party inference provider.

Requests from us:
- Can you provide a TCO model that shows reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go at projected 25k tokens/day and 100k tokens/day?
- We need a short champion kit for Lena and the exec sponsor (1 pager + 3-slide ROI summary) that Sarah can present.

I’ll introduce Lena on the procurement sync invite once you propose times. Tom will upload the standard SOW template to the Drive.

Regards,
Sarah Liu
Director, Product Data Platforms | DataVerge
sarah@dataverge.com | +1 (212) 555-0136

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@dataverge.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T12:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap — action items for enablement and champion support

Grace / Priyom — forwarding Sarah’s note and the recap. Action items for our side: 

- Grace: can you draft a 1-page "Champion Brief" targeted at Lena (VP Finance) — 3 bullets on financial impact, 2 lines on SLA/resilience, and 1 suggested ask for procurement (preferred PO language). Keep it slide-ready; we’ll keep it to a single printable page. Due: EOD Oct 6.

- Priyom: please draft the technical appendix for the procurement packet — include expected latency benchmarks (p50/p95 under 25k tokens/day), KV cache behavior notes, and a short runbook for the technical workshop. Also prepare a scoped POC checklist (6-week plan). Due: Oct 8.

- I will produce the TCO comparison (reserved vs on-demand) with clear assumptions and token pricing; I’ll also make a 3-slide ROI summary derived from the deck attached. Due: Oct 7.

Talk tracks for Sarah (quick bullets for champion):
- "We can stand up a 6-week POC to validate performance on our real prompts; Redwood will provide a scoped runbook and dedicated engineer for the pilot."
- "Early reserved capacity reduces per-token cost by ~35% vs on-demand at the volumes we discussed; we’ll show exact numbers in the TCO."
- "Security: Redwood provides SOC 2 evidence, inference-level event logs, and can integrate with your KMS for key control in Dedicated deployments."

I’ll schedule the procurement sync (30 mins) and tech workshop (60 mins) once we have a couple of proposed windows from Sarah/Tom.

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah@dataverge.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo recap — action items for enablement and champion support

Thanks Ben — I’ll take the Champion Brief and the 3-slide ROI summary. Quick notes: 

- Champion Brief outline (deliverable by Oct 6):
  * Header: "Why DataVerge should move forward with Redwood" (one-sentence value prop)
  * Top 3 economic points with estimated dollarized savings for two adoption scenarios
  * Short procurement ask: recommended PO language and standard lead times
  * One-line security reassurance with link to our SOC 2 packet

- I’ll attach a short security Q&A (security-answers.docx) with the most common fields legal/proc need. Priyom, I’ll need one sentence on KV cache persistence and where customer keys are handled (on-host vs KMS) to include.

Proposed meeting windows:
- Procurement sync (30m): Oct 12 at 16:00 ET or Oct 13 at 11:00 ET
- Technical workshop (60m): Oct 19 at 13:00 ET or Oct 20 at 10:00 ET

Sarah: please confirm which windows work for Lena and Tom and I’ll lock invites.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
grace@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: security-answers.docx
